verdict.score_rationale: The board is deliberate and readable with coherent regions and routing, but it lands in the 6–6.5 anchor because large dead bands, uneven regional density, and note-heavy sparse areas keep it from feeling fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The framed regions are clear, but broad unused bands across the center and within the lower-right and fleet panels make the canvas feel substantially underfilled.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Teal agents, blue storage, gray process/infrastructure shapes, and yellow notes form a restrained, legible palette, though most operational steps remain visually undifferentiated gray.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions or obvious waypoint artifacts are visible, and arrowheads generally terminate cleanly, though several long dashed routes and detached-looking label pills expose the routing structure.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Peer process boxes mostly share sizes and registers, but large shifts in density, long vertical runs, and oversized notes beside sparse icon areas weaken the overall rhythm and hierarchy.
